name: spring-dashpot elements
definition_zh: 用弹簧及阻尼器表征连接关系的理想化单元。
definition_en: An idealized connection represented by a spring and a damping element.
usage_overview: 用于将车辆悬挂、轨道层间、支座及结构—土体界面等连接或支承等效为刚度与阻尼关系，通过连接两端的相对位移和速度描述弹性传力与耗能作用，以建立各部件之间的动力耦合。

complete_examples.text: The two-stage suspensions are modelled as spring-dashpot elements to attenuate vehicle vibrations.
A cement asphalt mortar (CAM) layer is filled between the slab tracks and the subgrade, which is regarded as spring-dashpot elements continuously distributed along the line.
The tunnel and soil subsystems are coupled by the spring-dashpot elements.

Left rail Right rail In this work, 8-node iso-parametric element is applied to model the tunnel segments and using spring-dashpot elements to connect the tunnel segments, and then, 2-D Gauss—Legendre quadrature for bending is applied to form the tunnel ring—ring interaction matrix.

Under preconditions that the layered structures are connected by spring-dashpot elements, the mesh size of the finite element structures can be arbitrarily chosen, namely it allows highly flexible mesh adaptivity.

ANSYS® [37] is used to model the track using beam elements for rails and sleepers, spring-dashpot elements for the flexible layers, such as ballast and fasteners/ pads, and mass point elements to consider the ballast mass.
